title: Show explicit drug pair labels in interaction results

requirements.text: In the Drug Interaction Checker results (Drug-Drug tab), explicitly display the interacting drug pair (e.g., "Warfarin + Aspirin") for each pairwise interaction result so users can clearly see which two drugs the interaction report refers to. This drug-pair label must be shown for both cases: (1) when interaction details are available, and (2) when no interaction data is found for that pair (the label should still be shown alongside the no-data message).

quotes: please also show the drug pair interaction

acceptanceCriteria: After running "Check Interactions" with >= 2 drug names, each rendered pairwise result section/card includes a prominent drug-pair label in the format "<Drug A> + <Drug B>".
If the app shows a per-pair "no interaction data found" message, that message is displayed together with the drug-pair label for the same pair (not as a standalone message without the pair context).
The drug-pair label uses the same displayed drug names as the interaction object’s drugs fields (e.g., interaction.drugs.drugA and interaction.drugs.drugB), and is user-facing English text.

constraints: Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui or any other frontend immutablePaths.
Keep the existing single-actor Motoko backend architecture unchanged unless strictly required for this UI change.
nonGoals: Changing the interaction data source, dataset contents, or backend matching logic.
Adding new tabs or new interaction types beyond displaying the drug pair label.
